Read the following passage and answer the question by choosing the best option. Provide only the text of the correct option as your answer.

Passage: George Osborne should spread austerity over a longer period than currently planned to avoid damaging the economy, a leading global watchdog has claimed. The Chancellor looks set to use next month's Budget - the first since the Tories' dramatic election victory last month - to outline plans to balance the books by 2018-19. But the Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development suggested that the cuts required in 2016 and 2017 to return Britain to the black may be too harsh. The OECD urged the government to even out austerity over a longer period to 'lower its impact on growth'. Despite the warning, the Paris based think-tank said it again expects Britain to be the fastest growing major economy in the world this year.
@highlight
Osborne planning to balance the books by 2018-19 with deep cuts
@highlight
OECD warns the spending cuts should be spread over a longer period
@highlight
Downgrades UK growth to 2.4%  but still stronger than the rest of the G7
Query: 'The Chancellor should heed the @placeholder's warnings that 'continued weak productivity' could lead to 'a higher-than-expected budget deficit'.

Options : A. Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development
B. George Osborne
C. Budget
D. Downgrades UK
E. Tories
F. OECD
G. Britain
H. Paris
I. Osborne
J. G7

Provide the correct letter choice in \boxed{X}, where X is the contetn of the correct option.
